Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: complete.

TableTwinView now virtualizes rows, reports TABLE_VIEW/row/cell attributes, avoids redundant text notifications, sizes columns from content, and supports pinned selected rows. Plot semantics includes unplotted-row wording.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/plot/TableTwinViewFxSuite.scala:74 asserts <60 nodes for 5,000 rows plus TABLE_VIEW attributes
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/plot/TableTwinViewFxSuite.scala:185 asserts unchanged render does not notify text
- studio/viz/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/viz/plot/PlotKit.scala:442 includes unplotted rows in accessible text

Remaining / next action: No source-level acceptance gap found.

Disposition: Close: the stated bounded scope is complete; unrelated qualification remains under its own tickets.
